page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a baseline frequency of 2.55 GHz. The system is configured with 256 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance runs on the KVM hypervisor, does not include local storage, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the ecs.g7a.16xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% of tested configurations. This high processing capacity is reflected in strong scores for software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing. While cached memory bandwidth is highly efficient, uncached large-block read and write speeds fall within the average range. Cryptographic operations and database tasks also show strong performance, whereas static web serving and Redis SET operations perform at average levels.

With its dedicated AMD EPYC processor cores and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, this instance offers high resource density and predictable performance without hyperthreading overhead. It is well-suited for multi-threaded workloads such as software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale LLM inference tasks. The lack of bundled local storage requires users to rely on network-attached storage, making it a qualitative fit for enterprise applications and parallel processing tasks that do not require high-speed local NVMe drives.
